items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: some years after I was playing with Peanuts Hucko in England in Sheffield

ctx.x: He loaned me this 15 pounds, and whilst I was in Bermuda the bass player left. So the band leader said to me, he said, “Do you know a bass player?” I said, “Well I know this

guitar player that plays bass. He’s a good guitar player and he’s not a bad bass player.” He said, “What kind of a guy is he?” Because they were always concerned about the personality of bringing somebody out all that way. I said, “Oh, I know him, he’s very quiet,” I said, “but he won’t cause any trouble.” He said, “Well all right.” So anyway, out he comes. And I used to do a lot of wandering around Bermuda. And I went to the movies once and it was a movie about, I think it was a “Third Man” theme or something or…
Yeah. How’s the Communism going? Gee.
